3. Status report filed by way of affidavit of Mr. Abhimanyu Goyat, HPS, Assistant Commissioner of Police, Cyber, Faridabad, 1 of 3 Neutral Citation No:=2023:PHHC:122948 CRM-M-39422-2023 Neutral Citation: 2023:PHHC:122948 dated 13.09.2023, is also taken on record.

4. This Court, on 11.08.2023, granted interim bail to petitioner and relevant part of the same is recapitulated as under:-
"Contends inter alia
that matter has been amicably settled between the parties at their own level i.e. petitioner as well as respondent No.2.
Notice of motion for 04.09.2023.
In the meanwhile, petitioner shall join investigation before the Investigating Officer.

In the event of his arrest, the Arresting Officer would admit him to interim bail in the present case, till the next date of hearing, on his furnishing adequate bail and surety bonds to his satisfaction.

The petitioner is also directed to abide by all the conditions as envisaged under Section 438(2) of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973."
5.

Contends that in terms of the aforesaid order, petitioner has already joined investigation and his custodial interrogation is not required.
6.

Above factual position is duly acknowledged by learned State Counsel, on instructions from the police officer present in Court and further stated that custodial interrogation of the petitioner is not required at this stage.

7. Learned counsel for the complainant has also admitted the factum of amicable settlement between the parties and states that he would have no objection, in case, prayer made by the petitioner is accepted.
